title: Fine-grained Automated Failure Management for Extreme-Scale GPU Accelerated Systems
problem: As HPC systems scale, hardware failure rates increase; mean time to repair (MTTR) becomes critical bottleneck, with MTBF decreasing for GPU-accelerated systems
motivation: Future exascale systems will experience more frequent hardware failures; automated recovery strategies minimizing MTTR are essential for system availability and cost efficiency
method: Centralized meta-database tracking event history with correlated event analysis; fine-grained multi-strike repair policies; automated recovery framework deployed on Aurora supercomputer
key_novelty: First fine-grained automated failure management system for exascale GPUs; uses correlated event analysis and multi-strike policies for intelligent recovery
contributions: Centralized meta-database for event history and correlation analysis
Automated recovery framework with real-time decision making
84X reduction in MTTR compared to manual servicing on Aurora
limitations: Limited to Aurora deployment; generalizability to other systems not discussed; MTBF projection methodology not detailed
